text.p: Hurricane Hernan has crossed the coastline near Barra De Navidad Mexico, 20 miles west of Manzanillo. Hernan should be near the coast as it tracks towards the north-northwest today and Friday. Slow movement of the system means very heavy rains and flooding through the coastal areas. Very heavy rains means flash flooding and mudslides in the mountains. Strong winds impact coastal areas and also shipping from Manzanillo to Mazatlan.

Tropical storm Zane is only a threat to shipping about 600 miles southeast of Japan at this time. The storm is moving rapidly east at 30 mph and has top winds near 75 mph, which will weaken as the storm moves out to sea and becomes extratropical.

Disturbed weather in the western Gulf of Mexico is of some concern to shipping. Gusty winds and rough seas may cause a few minor problems. This area is being watched as it may develop to a tropical depression this period.
